newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends shade up in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends shade up in dull trade.

text.p: * Central bank sells about $29 million at 26.299
The Philippine peso ended slightly up in thin trade on Monday with the Central Bank emerging as the single biggest seller of dollars, traders said.
"Trading was very dull. Volume was also thin as most players just squared off their positions," said a dealer in one of the country's biggest banks.
The peso edged up to 26.298 to a U.S. dollar at the close after moving between 26.296 to 26.299.
